class Node:
    def __init__(self, val):
        self.val, self.next, self.child = val, None, None

def flatten(head):
    cur = head
    while cur:
        if cur.child:
            nxt = cur.next
            cur.next = cur.child
            cur.child = None
            tail = cur.next
            while tail.next:
                tail = tail.next
            tail.next = nxt
        cur = cur.next
    return head

a, b, c, d = Node(1), Node(2), Node(3), Node(4)
a.next, b.next = b, c
b.child = d           # 1 -> 2 -> 3, with child 4 under 2
head = flatten(a)
out = []
while head:
    out.append(head.val)
    head = head.next
print(out)
